summary: Teaches registering an Alloy collector in Fleet Management and checking its health, dashboards and logs.

needs.description: Host running Grafana Alloy (>=1.7.2) where learner can set env vars and restart the service, registered to the stack
needs.evidence: Before you begin: access to host where Alloy is installed; register-collector step

needs.description: At least one collector in Fleet Management Inventory reporting health, with self_monitoring_logs_* pipeline
needs.evidence: check-health-status: inspect first collector status; view-collector-logs

needs.description: Alloy internal metrics and self-monitoring logs in Cloud Prometheus/Loki so health dashboards and Explore Logs have data
needs.evidence: view-health-dashboards, view-collector-logs; troubleshooting 'dashboards have no data'

needs.description: Cloud admin able to create access policy token (set:alloy-data-write)

reviewNotes: Collector must be actually running outside Cloud; could be seeded by a long-lived Alloy in CI. Create-token step may mint new tokens on shared stack.
